description: A single desk light wakes an empty studio
prompt: Quiet creative studio before sunrise. A single warm desk lamp illuminates pale paper and a graphite pencil. Muted olive and warm ivory palette. Hold the frame; the lamp is the only moving element. No people, no text.

description: A hand begins drawing an impossible shape
prompt: Same paper and graphite pencil under the same warm lamp. Overhead close view of a hand tracing a smooth continuous loop. Keep hand anatomy stable and the paper texture consistent. One action only; no camera rotation, no text.

description: The paper shape rises into a small sculpture
prompt: A graphite loop on ivory paper lifts into a small matte olive sculpture. One continuous gentle rise. Warm side light from the desk lamp. Preserve the shape silhouette and paper position. No extra objects and no text.

description: The finished form rests in morning light
prompt: The same matte olive sculpture rests on the ivory sheet. Soft daylight enters from the left as the desk lamp dims. Gentle pull back; no object deformation. Leave the right third clear for an optional title added later.
